12.seo_title: Spy in a Bag: The Death of Gareth Williams Case File | Precision & Instinct
12.description: GCHQ mathematician Gareth Williams was found in a padlocked holdall in his London flat in 2010. Still unsolved. Clips from the Precision & Instinct debate.

13.seo_title: The Mad Gasser of Mattoon Case File | Precision & Instinct
13.description: In September 1944 a small Illinois town reported a mysterious gas attacker. Nobody was ever arrested. Clips from the Precision & Instinct debate.

feature.alt: Illustration: a balled-up cloth, a skeleton key and a lipstick tube on weathered porch boards at night
feature.blurb: A small Illinois town reported a mysterious gas attacker in September 1944. Nobody was ever arrested, and one porch left physical evidence behind.

14.seo_title: The Hall–Mills Murders Case File | Precision & Instinct
14.description: Two bodies under a crab apple tree in New Jersey, 1922. A family tried and acquitted in 1926. Clips from the Precision & Instinct debate.

feature.alt: Animated archival photograph: four men stand in an overgrown New Jersey field looking at the ground while a fifth crouches to examine it
feature.blurb: A minister and a choir singer were found under a crab apple tree in 1922. A family was tried and acquitted four years later, and the case is still unsolved.

15.seo_title: The Chicago Tylenol Murders Case File | Precision & Instinct
15.description: Seven people died in 1982 after taking poisoned Tylenol, and no one has ever been charged. Clips from the Precision & Instinct debate.

feature.alt: Animated archival-style photograph: a woman in a 1980s drugstore aisle sorts medicine boxes into a red basket in front of shelves of Tylenol and other pain relievers
feature.blurb: Seven people died in four days after taking Tylenol that someone had laced with cyanide. The recall came within weeks. No one was ever charged with the murders.

16.seo_title: The Disappearance of Jimmy Hoffa Case File | Precision & Instinct
16.description: Jimmy Hoffa vanished from a Detroit-area parking lot in 1975 and no one has ever been charged. Clips from the Precision & Instinct debate.

feature.alt: Animated archival photograph: cars pass the Machus Red Fox steakhouse in suburban Detroit in black and white
feature.blurb: The most powerful labor leader in America left home for a lunch meeting on July 30, 1975, and was never seen again. No one has ever been charged.
